answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wharf of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the reef re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
